label: PF Backlog 157
title: Static centralized views: logs index.html + traceability.html (pre-dashboard)
body:
core/views.py generates self-contained HTML BEFORE the dashboard exists: products//logs/index.html (runs -> agents -> log files + backend log) and products//traceability.html (id hub matrix: features/requirements/business scope/architecture/tests + coverage gaps + undeclared prefixes). Reads the same stores the dashboard will consume (log INDEX.json, traceability.json id_index) so UI and dashboard agree. Wired into stage_runner (refresh on stage complete) and runnable via `python -m core.views --project

`. Verified: 90 ids rendered, KPIs + tables.

dashboard_impact.reason: Static pre-dashboard views; the dashboard (BI-0129/0130) supersedes but reuses the same data.

_note: Implemented core/views.py; wired into stage_runner; compileall=0 wired_audit=0.
